title: Owner approves or amends the split plan
goal: The owner decides D1–D6 before any rule text moves
acceptance: The decision and any amendment are recorded in the plan and F-078 with the date
escalation: Rule text moves only after this decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: reading a two-page plan with six decisions. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-14: decided in the session (D1, D3–D6 as written; D2 amended).
